One of the great benefits of the tax cut we passed, that has not gotten a lot of attention, is a new tax break for Arkansas families who give to churches and charities.

Under the old law, families who took the standard deduction, which is the vast majority of Arkansans, generally received no federal tax deduction for charitable giving.

Now, married couples can deduct up to $2,000 in charitable contributions, including tithing, even while taking the standard deduction.
